title: Who the (Bleep) Did I Marry?
description:
S07 E10 — The Killer Beside Me
Single mom, Wilda Gadd, finds a family-oriented single dad who seems like the perfect life partner, until he devolves into a dangerous monster; she's the only one who can bring him to justice.

title: Who the (Bleep) Did I Marry?
description:
S07 E02 — What Happened Off Camera
TV news anchorwoman Marisa Burke and her seemingly perfect husband Mark Kandel become the eye of a media storm when Mark's twisted double life starts making headlines.

title: Who the (Bleep) Did I Marry?
description:
S07 E03 — Bad and Blue
When Isaiah Carvalho meets NYPD officer Valerie Cincinelli, he thinks his dreams have come true; he soon learns she's not only cheating but also hired a hitman to kill him.

title: Who the (Bleep) Did I Marry?
description:
S07 E08 — Mark the Mark
A single father finally finds a love with whom he can grow old; however, just months after they've wed, she depletes his retirement savings, and he learns he's only the latest in a string of victims; when he files for divorce, things get much worse.

title: Who the (Bleep) Did I Marry?
description:
S07 E07 — The Id and the Ego
When a beautiful student meets an esteemed psychologist, she believes she found her soulmate; when he suddenly disappears, she discovers he lived a bizarre double life in Detroit's most notorious neighborhood.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
Inferno of Hate
A lifelong resident of his neighborhood despairs when he sees it descend into vice and criminality; vowing to restore it to an oasis of clean living, he turns his fiery wrath on all those he deems responsible with horrifically tragic results.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S08 E10 — The Filth and the Fury
A retired couple's golden years shatter when a troubled Army veteran moves in next door and makes their lives hell with his appalling behavior; they declare war, fighting vicious battles until one of these neighbors turns up dead.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S08 E04 — Unwelcome to the Neighborhood
The unofficial mayor of an idyllic suburban street locks horns with the new neighbor who shows no respect for local values; disagreements escalate to arguments, threats, and property damage, ending in brutal violence that shatters two families.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S08 E07 — A Ticking Time Bomb
A long-time resident of a suburban street descends into a morass of delusion, anger and paranoia that turns him against innocent neighbors; he eventually becomes wholly unhinged and unleashes his violent wrath upon his small Baltimore community.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S08 E08 — Gone to the Dogs
A friendly retired couple delights a family with young children when they move in next door. Then the new neighbors' dog attacks the children's mother, setting off a vicious conflict that ends in two shocking murders.

Laura finds that her Good Samaritan is actually a wolf in sheep's clothing.

title: Married to Evil
description:

Deborah Jones and Gerard Pepin seem like the perfect match until a dark accusation tears their marriage apart; as the scale of Gerard's wrongdoing comes to light, Deborah decides to fight to bring him to justice, whatever the personal cost.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor

New neighbors disrupt the harmony that has existed between residents for years; alliances change and terror reigns until a winter storm puts a bloody end to the feud.

description:
S01 E04 — You Know What Time It Is
A mother of two is shot to death outside her apartment complex just minutes after returning home from her 30th birthday celebration; after interviewing multiple witnesses and suspects, Detective Fil Waters uncovers a shocking lead caught on video.

title: The Interrogator
description:
S01 E05 — The Murders at Immaculate Auto Sales
Two generations of Contreras family members are shot in broad daylight while they are working at their family-owned car dealership; Detective Fil Waters boils it all down thanks to an eyewitness, a scorned woman and a videotape.

title: The Interrogator
description:
S01 E01 — Missing on Christmas Eve
A woman experiences her worst nightmare when her 12-year-old son is abducted on Christmas Eve; Detective Fil Waters soon learns that the child has gone missing before and will stop at nothing to solve the case.

title: The Interrogator
description:
S01 E02 — Overkill
A teenager finds her neighbor, Rebecca Claybrook, beaten to death in her home; it is obvious to Detective Fil Waters that the victim knew her killer, and he puts the men in Claybrook's life under the microscope.

title: Homicide City
description:
S03 E01 — Tragedy Strikes Lorena's
A birthday ends in tragedy when a beloved family is found brutally murdered; detectives are left in the dark until a chance encounter changes everything.

title: Homicide City
description:
S03 E02 — Shattered Dreams
A 17-year-old aspiring artist is found dead in an abandoned house; a devastated family worries the case will never be solved, but 13 years later a lucky break in DNA technology points detectives in the right direction.

title: Homicide City
description:
S03 E05 — Winters Bones
A skeleton is discovered on the edge of a high school football field, during a game of catch. It takes a forensic sculptor, tireless detective work, and some luck, to finally bring the mysterious killer to justice.

title: Homicide City
description:
S03 E09 — The Kensington Strangler
After a nursing student is found brutally murdered in a dilapidated part of Philadelphia, detectives get on the trail of a serial killer who is targeting women.

title: Valley of the Damned
description:
S01 E06 — Impossible Perpetrator
After teenager Candace Hiltz is shot dead in Prison Valley, the police pursue her troubled brother, James; with no evidence against him, the case goes cold until 10 years later when evidence is discovered in a police officer's storage unit.

title: Valley of the Damned
description:
S01 E05 — The Jehovah Jinx
The police encounter a bizarre murder case while investigating a deadly home invasion in which Jehovah's Witness Pam Candelario's body is found at the scene and her husband Ralph is brutally beaten.

title: Valley of the Damned
description:
S01 E04 — The Second Shot
When Dianne Hood is gunned down outside a community center in Prison Valley, no one can understand why anyone would want to murder the well-liked housewife; the answer involves betrayal, greed and obsession, in an infamous love-triangle murder plot.

title: Valley of the Damned
description:
S01 E01 — The Kill List
Prison Valley is rocked by the murder of Prisons Chief Tom Clements; the police think it's part of a wider plot, including the death of pizza delivery man Nathan Leon, and they're running out of time to catch the killer.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S03 E01 — I Am Strange
A lone gunman shoots a young man and woman on their way home from the gym where they work; while interrogating a suspect, detectives learn that this is no random attack but the twisted plan of a deranged psychopathic stalker.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S03 E06 — I'm Just a Sick Murderer
An officer responds to a 911 call placed by a robber on the lam who feels compelled to turn himself in; when the officer arrives at the scene, the criminal confesses to much more than breaking and entering.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S02 E04 — Diary of a Psychopath
A college student disappears at the start of his freshman year without a trace, leaving his family and his girlfriend reeling; when authorities look to his best friend for answers, they uncover a love triangle gone wrong.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S02 E02 — Fantasy Over Family
A troubled 29-year-old son is kicked out of his parents' house after spending the family fortune on a webcam model; his mother, father and brother are found murdered, the young man insists he's innocent.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S04 E02 — Sleeping Beauties
First responders arrive at a home in Ontario, where a mother leads officers to the dead bodies of her two children; an investigation yields a twisted truth: this tragedy isn't an accident but a carefully crafted killing by a vengeful psychopath.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S04 E08 — I Call Him Monster
Police respond to the site of a fiery car crash alongside a Michigan highway, where they discover the badly burned body of a young woman; investigators quickly realize this is no accident but a cold-blooded murder plot.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S03 E03 — Do Her Mortal Harm
The naked and mutilated body of a mother turns up at the bottom of a ravine in Baton Rouge, La.; when tire tracks lead investigators to a suspect, they encounter an undetected serial killer who confesses to butchering eight women over a decade.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S03 E04 — I Killed Him. Boom. Boom.
Police respond to a 911 call to find a father dead in his home with more than 15 gunshot wounds.

Photos discovered on an old cell phone help solve the disappearance of a 14-year-old girl.

An emotional 911 call comes in from a young man claiming he just found his mother and dog murdered in their home; once his interview with detectives begins, they uncover a parasitic psychopath who will do anything to get away with the crime.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S11 E19 — That's When My Nightmare Started
A small SD card contains horrifying images and videos of a woman's murder; when someone gives it to Anchorage police, detectives come face-to-face with a sexual psychopath who has a shocking tale to tell.

title: Toxic
description:

Yeardley Love is days from graduation when her UVA lacrosse player boyfriend, George Huguely, breaks into her room and kills her; Elizabeth Chambers examines the warning signs, missed intervention, and the legacy her family builds from tragedy.

description:

Bridget Shiel, a 19-year-old escort and rap video dancer, meets a brutal end in 2016 when someone shoots her and leaves her naked in an Atlanta park.

description:
S03 E01 — Last Dance
Fresh from a breakup, a Playboy casting assistant revels in the L.A. nightlife scene until a wild night out ends in her mysterious death.

title: The Playboy Murders
description:
S03 E04 — The Doctor and the Bunny
As a Playboy Bunny, Jackie Hendrickson is forbidden from fraternizing with her customers; Atlanta plastic surgeon Dr. Warren Brown is impossible to resist, and their illicit affair sets off a deadly chain of events.

title: Grave Mysteries
description:
S02 E02 — Mother Gone Missing
Thirty-two-year-old Becky Brosnan goes missing; while a Myspace message says she's left to find herself, everyone says Becky would never abandon her children; now, detectives must piece together Becky's life to uncover what really happened to her.

title: Grave Mysteries
description:
S02 E08 — Death on the Highway
Twenty-eight-year-old Michael Sandy is an interior designer living in Williamsburg, Brooklyn; Michael loves music and making new friends on the internet; but his habit of trusting strangers he meets on the web will put his life in jeopardy.

title: Grave Mysteries
description:
S02 E07 — New Year's Nightmare
Mikarah Sanders is shot in a home invasion on New Year's Eve; police dive into Sanders' digital world, learning that the killer has been under their noses all along, driven by rage to commit a shocking crime of passion.

title: Grave Mysteries
description:
S02 E01 — Ultimate Betrayal
A couple returns home from a trip to find blood everywhere, signs of struggle and their teenage daughter missing; police stumble across her charred remains in the desert; digital clues soon lead police to a shocking secret and a deadly betrayal.

title: Diabolical
description:
S02 E10 — When All Else Fails
After her home is invaded and her husband murdered, Shaunna Dodd recounts her harrowing ordeal at gunpoint; however, when investigators dig deeper, they uncover a tale of lies, infidelity and shady characters who have wandered into the Washoe Valley.

title: Diabolical
description:
S02 E06 — Control Freak
Donna Scrivo hasn't seen her adult son, Ramsay, in days, and she's worried; she alerts the police, but days pass with no sign of him anywhere; then the discovery of a severed head and body parts along a highway reveals an act of shocking violence.

title: Diabolical
description:
S02 E09 — Murder Is No Accident
After Cynthia Roth drowns in the middle of a crowded lake, investigators uncover a decades-long trail of terror; detectives must take extraordinary measures to catch the killer.

title: Diabolical
description:
S02 E01 — Mother of All Lies
In 2015, Detective Scott Sanderson finds himself investigating one of the strangest cases of his career, involving a missing woman and her newborn; before long, he uncovers a diabolical scheme that will destroy the lives of everyone it touches.

title: American Monster
description:
S09 E08 — Two Anniversaries
Family comes first to grandparents Ron and Kay Wilson; though they may not have much money, their growing brood always knows how to make their own fun; something evil is prowling close to home and not everyone makes it out alive.

title: American Monster
description:
S09 E10 — Gone Hunting
Police officer Albert Pacheco and his wife Cathy live on Hawaii's Big Island, raising four kids in the bosom of their close-knit church community; what looks like a household steeped in traditional goodness is hiding something evil.

title: American Monster
description:
S12 E07 — Til Death Do Us Part
Christy Blankenship is stolen from her family on what should be a joyous day, when police find her dead at home, with a gunshot wound to her head; her husband insists it's a terrible accident.; only that morning he had vowed 'til death do us part.

title: American Monster
description:
S12 E04 — Broken People
When Jeff Silvernail returns home to find his partner, Lori, dead in a pool of blood, it appears to be a burglary gone horribly wrong; investigators must uncover whether Jeff is a heartbroken partner or a monster who couldn't cope with rejection.

title: American Monster
description:
S12 E09 — Something About Him
Rogelio Morales is a handsome Marine who sweeps Margarita Sanchez Lemus off her feet; their whirlwind romance leads to marriage and the birth of a beautiful son; behind Rogelio's winning smile lurks a monster who will soon show his true colors.

title: American Monster
description:
S13 E08 — My Brother's Keeper
Behind closed doors, India Mackey's relationship with her boyfriend is painful; one day after her 20th birthday, India learns what he is truly capable of.

title: The Serial Killer Connection
description:
S01 E02 — Behind Closed Doors
Following a serial killer's military postings, Bonnie and Kara investigate murders in Maine, possible victims in San Diego, and chilling evidence in Virginia suggesting the serial killer's crimes stretched far beyond those officially known.

title: The Serial Killer Connection
description:
S01 E03 — The Final Secret
Bonnie and Kara confront the final chapter of their investigation as survivors identify a notorious serial killer, investigators revisit his known victims, and the women reflect on their search for justice after decades of unanswered questions.

title: Six Degrees of Murder
description:
S02 E06 — Dream Home
Peruvian immigrant Elizabeth Palomino is a shining light to everyone who knows her, then she is murdered, and police investigate whether there could be more to Palomino's American success story than meets the eye.

title: Six Degrees of Murder
description:
S02 E02 — A Fresh Start
Single mother Christina Sanoubane leaves her abusive boyfriend to move into her own apartment, then, four days later, Sanoubane's toddler tells a visitor to the apartment that his mother is dead.

title: The Killer Beside Me
description:
S02 E04 — Deadly Business
In Tacoma, Wash., businessman Robert Henry is murdered by a masked gunman, and his wife, Paula, points the finger at Henry's former business associate, Larry Shandola.

title: The Killer Beside Me
description:
S02 E03 — Almost Home
After Gayle Isleib is shot to death on April 30, 1996, police identify her coworker, Tyrone Montgomery, as her killer; they find love poems as well as evidence that Montgomery planned to kidnap Isleib and murder her husband.

title: The Killer Beside Me
description:
S02 E06 — Screaming Terror
Alice Hufnagle is raped and murdered on Nov. 22, 2002; after following numerous leads and dead ends, police find the vital clues that lead them to Jeffery Vample, Alice's co-worker at a local pharmacy.

title: The Killer Beside Me
description:
S02 E01 — Roadside Murder
Theresa Wesolowski, 22, is murdered on May 29, 1999; police are baffled for nearly 10 years before finally getting a break when a new DNA technique identifies Wesolowski's coworker, Mark Libecki, as her killer.

title: Fatal Vows
description:
S06 E04 — The Bad Apple
Francis Nicky Nicolosi and his devout new wife, Ellie, are living out the perfect retirement, then one of them is found dead in an apple orchard; police discover there's more to this seemingly frail and religious couple than anyone imagined.

title: Fatal Vows
description:
S06 E13 — Bored to Death
When Opal Skidmore marries Steven Williams, their love is a second chance for the pair to live out their dreams; soon, boredom and the lure of the open road spark hidden desires and sexual hijinks, leaving this open marriage anything but happy.

title: Fatal Vows
description:
S06 E02 — Behind Closed Doors
Nurses Lara Crockett and Ricardo Muscolino meet on the night shift; he sets about creating a rich life for them, and she's happy to go along with it; Ricardo's scheming eventually drives Lara into the arms of another man with explosive results.

title: Fatal Vows
description:
S06 E07 — Murder, Modesty, and the Pastor
Corinne Stoudt gets a second chance at love with husband Calvin, then a too-close roommate and a monstrous past turn this second chance into a deadly battleground.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S05 E01 — Highway of Horrors
In 1992, a college student disappears after her car breaks down on the highway; family and friends join police in a frantic search that hits one setback after another; it may take new advances in DNA technology to finally crack this stubborn case.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S05 E08 — The Price of Fame
In 2001, actor Robert Blake finds his new wife, Bonny Lee Bakley, shot in the head in the couple's car; the largest homicide investigation in LAPD history uncovers a story of blind ambition and betrayal.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S05 E02 — Jenner Beach Murders
A Christian couple's weekend getaway takes a tragic turn when they are found murdered on a northern California beach; satanic imagery found nearby leads local sheriff's deputies on a manhunt.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S05 E11 — Red Christmas
In December 2003, police respond to a mysterious 911 call at a home in Mansfield, Texas; when authorities enter, they discover two bodies; the key to finding the killer is within one of the victim's grasp.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S05 E05 — Blood Ties
A college student who is working as a radio station intern is murdered, launching a long and frustrating investigation that leaves family and police on the brink of hopelessness; forensic genealogy leads to a man who has been on the run for decades.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S05 E09 — A Crimson End
Two members of a prominent family are murdered in Arkansas, and a teenager is arrested; for 24 years, one woman believes the teen is innocent.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S09 E06 — Looking for Angela
In Prairie Village, Kan., a reclusive mother goes missing in 2019; when her teenage daughter and the police go looking for answers, they are gaslit at every turn; without a digital footprint or even a friend who knows her, leads are running out fast.

title: Mean Girl Murders
description:
S03 E03 — Tough Cookies
At the cookie factory, friendships rise fast but so do rivalries; what starts as harmless gossip between co-workers soon turns sour; when jealousy and ambition boil over, the sweet life at the plant ends in cold-blooded murder.
